oil.when: 2017–2018 using the Driver Information Center controls on the right of the steering wheel
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition on, use the DIC controls on the right side of the steering wheel to bring up REMAINING OIL LIFE in the instrument cluster.
Press and hold SEL until the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message clears and oil life shows 100%.
oil.note: Checked in the 2017 and 2018 owner's manuals.

steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on with the engine off and bring up REMAINING OIL LIFE on the Driver Information Center.
Push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up three times within five seconds.
Check that oil life reads 100%. If CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON is still showing or returns at the next start, repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2017 and 2018 owner's manuals.

tpms.when: 2017–2018 after the low tire pressure light came on
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label in the driver's door opening.
There is no reset button: the low tire pressure light stays on until the pressures are corrected, then goes out.
Check that the light has gone out. If it stays on, recheck all four tires with a gauge and have the system checked if they are correct.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2017 and 2018 owner's manuals. The light can come on at the first start on a cold morning and go out as you drive; that is an early sign the tires need air. If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that inflating the tires will not clear.

notes: The oil life system does not reset itself after an oil change, so reset it every time, and only after the oil has actually been changed.
